gsungs pa/ /rdo rje khro bo ag tshar che zer/skyes bu che/ /thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /snying g.yon/khar mnan pa'i khu tshur 'dzug/g.yas na rang gi

tei:div.tei:p: ag tshar che zer/ skyes bu che/ /thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /snying g.yon/ khar mnan pa'i khu tshur 'dzug /g.yas na rang gi rang*/ mtshon cha 'phyar/ /gshin rje gsod pa'i rdo rje tho ba/ dbyig tho ste/ gzhan gyis mi thub rdo rje'i sa mtshan pa'i/ dbyig/rta mgrin la ni dbang mchog pad+ma/ dmar/ /mi rdo rje/ phyed bdud rtsi'i thabs sbyor la/ /ṭak+ki rgyal po'i mi g.yo/ lcags kyu ste/ /dbyig sngon rdo rjes mtshan pa'i/ can la rang gi ming*/ /stobs kyi rgyal po rtse gsum pa/ /mi a tsa la/ g.yo'i ba'i ral gri nyid zer/ yi ger dkyil 'khor ral gri/ rtse/ /tsha skyob dkar gdugs/ po rgyal po la/ / zer/ chos kyi 'khor lo rnam par bsgom/ /gtun shing rdo rje rkang 'og la/ /zhabs g.yon brkyang pas gnas pa'o/ /dbang sku mdog po sngon po'i rnam pa ltar/ /mthar gshin rje/ byed rnam par bsgom par bya/ /gzhan lho'i/ gyis mi thub rdo rje ni/ /'jigs byed zla ba'i nor bu 'dra/ /pad+ma'i nub kyi/ khro bo dmar po che/ /rdo byang gi rje bdud rtsi'i bdag nyid gnag /mtshams kyi khro bo cher gnag cing*/ /spyi bor rdo mi bskyod pa/ rje 'dzin pa 'dzin/ /gshin rje rnam snang nyid kyis te/ / mtshan te/ rdo rje sems dpas dbyig pa can/ /pad+ma'i mthar byed/ khro bo rnam gzigs 'od dpag med/ rjes/ /rdo rje sems dpas byang ni/ thabs sbyor la/ /rdo de rnams bstan nas/ rje dkyil 'khor dbus sna tshogs/ gnas par/ rdo rje nyi ma bsgom par bya/ /'og nyi ma'i/ tu pad+ma'i gdan bsams nas/ khro de'i steng nas gang tsam du 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa la/ bo bcu rnams rab bsgom bya/ /ye shes rdo rje ste rnal 'byor pa rangapa*/ rang dbus su/ / bsgom/ bcu phyed dkyil 'khor mi bskyod pa la sogs pa lnga po gang rung gi dkyil 'khor bsgom/ bdag nyid de/ /bdud rnams zhabs kyi 'og bsam nas/ / dkyil rigs lnga'i/ 'khor lnga po bsgom par bya/

/bsrung ba'i 'khor lo gzi brjid che | | bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba ste/ /'khor zhing rab shin tu 'khor bar/ tu mi g.yo bar/ /dpag tshad brgya yi tshad tsam mo/ /bsrung ba'i bsgom pa las mi 'da' bas/ dam tshig stobs kyis rnam par rgyal ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas bcom ldan dpa' nyon mongs pa'i g.yul las rgyal bas/ chen po/ /rang gi byin rlabs rim gnas te/ /rang gi byin rlabs rnal 'byor gyis/ /de nyid las ni bshad par bya/ /snying rang mi bskyod par skyed pa yin na de'i/ gi dbus su zla bsgom par/ bar gyur | | gzugs brnyan zla bar ma bcom hūm̐ pa/ /sna hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ tshog sa 'od kyis yang dag khyab/ /de las rdo rje sngon po nas tsam/ bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje rdo rje la hūm̐ de las 'od sngon po thur du 'phros pas/ bdag med nang ltar aṃ/ mkha' tshon gang*/ 'gro ma// cho 'od kyis/ gas aṃ/ skul bas 'bar ba/ bsgom par snying kha'i hūm̐ zhu ste byang sems babs/ bya/ / mkha' nang ltar bdag med ma ste aṃ gyi rnam par rang la bya/ yang na kha kha mu kha'i steng du/ 'gro'i sna yi 'og gi rtse mo/ mthar gnas pa/ / thig le/ nyungs dkar tsam du rnam par sgom/ /nyungs de nyid 'gro ba thams cad kyi ngo bor mos pa bya'o// dkar las 'od spros te sems can gyi don byas nas slar bsdu/ de nas gnas la sogs pa bdag la bsdu/ rang yang thig ler bsdus nas bdag nyid la bsgom pa'am | de phra ba'i tshul du mi dmigs par bya ba'am rang gi blo la bzhag ni 'gro ba kun/ khams gsum rgyu dang mi rgyu ba/ /de ltar sgom par byed pa yi/ /rang gi byin brlabs rab tu 'grub/ / de ltar bsgoms pas rang byin gyis brlabs pa'i ye shes skyes pa'i dus su/ gzugs sgra de bzhin dri dang ni/ /ro dang reg bya mngon 'dod pa/ /der ni rnal 'byor nyid kyis ni/ /mi 'dzin yul de dag tu mi rtog

de phyir bdag gzhan med/ /ji dper na/ ltar rdor pad las byung ba/ /zhi lhan cig skyes pa'i rtog pa zhi ba ltar 'di la/ ba'i bde ba'i rnam par 'dod/ / rtog pa'i rba rlabs gnyis su/ med cing snang ba med/ /rnam rtog med cing yi ge 'gyur ba med pa'am brjod pa med pa'o// med/ /myos byed byang sems/ cung las rgya bungaX zur gcig bstan/ zad rab 'thungs 'dzin pa/ pa'i/ / mi rtog pa mngon du byas pa/ bdag nyid bdag med pa ni bdag gis rig bdag gis mi rig go / ste zhen pa'am bdag tu yang mi rtog go / dga' bral dga' ba dag gi mthar/ / lhan skyes myong ba'i dus su/ rtog pa'i drwa ba rnam par spangs/ /'gyur rtog pa'i mtshan ma/ med 'khrul pa las 'das shing*/ / snying rje dang shes rab gnyis med/ kye yi rdo rje'i rnam par zhu bde tha mi dad/ gsal/ /bems rab tu gsal ba tsam yin pas/ min rnam pa he ru ka / bdud rtsi lnga/ rnam pa yi ge a yis yongs su bskor zer/ rnams zhu bde tha mi dad yin pas/ kyis yongs su bskor/ /rang dbang gi gnas su byas pa gnyis med ye shes/ nyid mgon po he ru ka /de yis bdag nyid mi yul du byas pa'i tshul gyis/ rig cing*/ /de yi dus na thams thams cad gnyis med lhan skyes/ cad rig / de ltar bsgoms pas rang gis phyag rgya chen po thob pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'byung po'i 'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar ni| 'gro dang 'ong ba ni/ /rang lhan skyes bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ gis kun phyag rgya chen po thob pa'i dus su gnyis med rang gi ngo bo mkhyen lta bur gzigs/ /sangs phung po lnga/ rgyas sangs dbang po drug rgyas sras po dang*/ /yan lag lnga/ kun dang bu ga dgu/ kun/ /mgo rtsa sum cu rtsa gnyis/ bo'i drwa ba dhū tīr skud par bcas/ / de lta bu'i/ lus de kun gyi ngo bo/ ni yod min ltar gzigs shing*/ / phyag rgya chen po thob pa'i/ skad cig kye rdo rje gzugs 'dzin// 'ja' tshon lta bu zhal phyag gi rnam pa can/

ji ltar nam mkha' mi dmigs shing*/ /mtshan ma med cing ma byung dang*/ /gos mtshan ma'i rtog pas/ pa med cing 'khrul pa med/ /sgrib pa lnga ni rnam par spangs/ /ji ltar me long gzugs brnyan ni/ /rtogs snang la rang bzhin med par rtogs nas/ nas bden pa rnam spangs pa/ /de bzhin bdag nyid he ru ka'i | | lha'i rnam pa lta bur snang yang yang dag pa'i rang bzhin/ gsal bar mthong*/ /de nyid snang ba/ don dang dbang po dang*/ /phung po nam mkha' lta bur rang bzhin med/ yod// lus kyi ngo bo/ ni bde zag med/ ba nyid brjod cing*/ /'du las dang nyon mongs pas bskyed pa'i/ byed rnams kyis zil 'khor bas mi rdzi/ mi gnon/ / de'i phyag rgya chen po thob pa'i dus su/ gzugs de'i rgyu mtshan 'khor ba la mi gnas pas/ ni mig gis mi 'dzin mi zhen/ te/ /sgra sgrar zhen med 'og ma la yang 'gre/ ni thos pa po yis rna ba/ min/ /lce yis ro ni mi tshor te/ /dri ni sna yis kyang ma yin/ /reg bya lus kyi gong bus min/ / mya ngan las 'das pa la mi gnas te mi zhen/ de ltar zhen pa med na de rnams kyi bya ba mi byed dam zhe na/ 'on kyang chos sku zag med kyi| bde chen tshul nyams su myong ba'i/ las ni/ / gnyis med ye shes kyi snang bar gyur pa'i/ bud 'od rig med bzang mo mthong bas bde/ /rna gnyis med snang bar rtogs pa'am shes pa ste/ ba glu yi bde thob pa las kyang*/ ba bzang*/ /snom pas dri yi bde ba che/ /skye gnas reg pa'i bde chen dang*/ /ro yi btung ba'i sbyor ba las/ /gang gis bde bar shar/ ba de lus ( sus ) 'gog par byed/ /bde ba chen pos 'gro ba thams cad la/ khyab/ / zag med/ bde ba chen po/ ma gtogs mi par logs na bde ba yod par/ shes so/ /sangs rgyas byang chubaX sems dpa' yang*/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang btsun mo bzang*/ /sangs rgyas lnga dang du ma ni/ /bde bar de thams cad zag med/ phyin cing rnam par sad/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das kyi bde ba chen po
yis thams cad la khyab pa 'i tshig thos nas 'di dag smras pa/ dkar po rnam gsum dang 'phags pa'i gsung rab kha skong pod gnyis pa/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ sa skya bka' 'bum/ PAGE 116PAGE 113
